verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Grafana serves a working llms.txt at grafana.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) plus markdown-accessible docs pages (.md suffix returns clean docs content), directly enabling agents to consume agent-oriented documentation. This is corroborated by first-party docs and an OpenAPI spec, giving multiple machine-readable paths into the docs. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of agents actually using llms.txt in practice.
